title: Create a storyboard first, then feed the storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to guide…
content:
Create a storyboard first, then feed the storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to guide the video generation for more control and consistency.  
Use an LLM to analyze your storyboard and convert it into higher-quality Seedance prompts before generating the video.
